描述_EN: in the han dynasty (206bc-ad220) grave goods included replicas of domestic and wild animals made from pottery but in reduced size, such as this figure of a ram. the grave goods would allow the deceased to continue a similar life style in the underworld.
描述_ZN: 汉代（公元前206年-公元220年）的墓葬物品包括用陶器制作的家畜和野生动物的复制品，但尺寸缩小，如这个公羊的形象。 年，这些墓葬用品可以让死者在冥界继续保持类似的生活方式。
